content: {"like":["Values visually striking and dynamic imagery, especially in 3D and cinematic lighting;","Prefers emotionally resonant stories with strong performances and thoughtful direction;","Enjoys films that blend cultural elements (Spanish, Indian, etc.) with high production quality;","Appreciates music that enhances narrative and mood, including iconic soundtracks;","Seeks unique, non‑conventional storytelling with open‑ended or surprising conclusions."],"dislike":["Dislikes poor 3D quality and small, nested screens;","Avoids short or poorly paced movies;","Rejects mono audio and low video quality;","Dislikes mispronunciations or accent errors in performances;","Prefers not to watch films with overly Hollywoodish or generic endings."]}
